summary.text: Jeanne Albert is a Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a member of the Lincoln School District school board, an at-large seat with a term ending in 2028.

paragraphs.text: Jeanne Albert sought the Democratic nomination for the Addison-4 District in 2024 and lost the primary to Mari Cordes and Herb Olson.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026, alongside incumbent Karen Lueders, with 1,249 votes to Lueders' 1,246.
